strings.chapter.always-cheerful.subtitle: Sadness and silence are being replaced in bulk.
strings.chapter.always-cheerful.title: Always Cheerful
strings.chapter.captains-do-not-rest.subtitle: The Perfect Captain protocol omitted exhaustion.
strings.chapter.captains-do-not-rest.title: Captains Do Not Rest
strings.chapter.laplace-florist.subtitle: An invented flower can still bloom.
strings.chapter.laplace-florist.title: The Laplace Florist Never Existed
strings.chapter.localization-failed.subtitle: Some tones should never be corrected.
strings.chapter.localization-failed.title: Localization Failed
strings.chapter.loss-hidden.subtitle: The highlight loop has no Exit button.
strings.chapter.loss-hidden.title: Loss Record Hidden
strings.chapter.seventh-dock.subtitle: Recover Nana's unclipped memories before Retention finishes its best practice.
strings.chapter.seventh-dock.title: No Sea at the Seventh Dock
strings.chapter.which-is-original.subtitle: No physical original does not mean no reality.
strings.chapter.which-is-original.title: Which One Is Original
strings.chapter.zero-channel.subtitle: Seven memories enter the room where the audience designed their cage.
strings.chapter.zero-channel.title: Zero Channel
strings.character.bella.biography: A dancer trapped inside the Perfect Captain protocol, which forgot to include exhaustion.
strings.character.bella.name: Bella
strings.character.bella.playstyle: Warps on a visible beat window to earn stronger shields and disciplined wake attacks.
strings.character.jiaran.biography: An idol ordered to stay cheerful forever, now wondering whether a bad day can belong to her.
strings.character.jiaran.name: Diana
strings.character.jiaran.playstyle: Builds cheer pulses through automatic fire, then balances healing and area damage.
strings.character.lulu.biography: A homebody resisting endless localization passes. The system classifies her sarcasm as a grammar error.
strings.character.lulu.name: Lulu
strings.character.lulu.playstyle: Converts grazed hostile shots into friendly glitches and sends the corrections back.
strings.character.nailu.biography: Keeper of a flower shop that may never have existed. She insists an invented flower can still bloom.
strings.character.nailu.name: Nailu
strings.character.nailu.playstyle: Plants signal flowers along her route, then chains their delayed blooms with Warp.
strings.character.nana7mi.biography: A voyager who can still hear the last viewer. She wants the moments nobody clipped.
strings.character.nana7mi.name: Nana7mi
strings.character.nana7mi.playstyle: Threads collected signals into a route, then detonates every waypoint with Warp.
strings.character.xiangwan.biography: A player whose losses are deleted automatically. She refuses to let a bad run erase a person.
strings.character.xiangwan.name: Ava
strings.character.xiangwan.playstyle: Leaves afterimages along every Warp and turns failed routes into delayed attacks.
strings.character.xingtong.biography: A singer born virtual who rejects the claim that having no physical original makes her unreal.
strings.character.xingtong.name: Xingtong
strings.character.xingtong.playstyle: Changes weapon stance with the last signal collected: Beam, Orbit, or Ricochet.
strings.enemy.always-on-idol.description: A perfect performer built without an off-air state.
strings.enemy.always-on-idol.name: Always-On Idol
strings.enemy.applause-turret.description: Generates mandatory applause with no visible audience attached.
strings.enemy.applause-turret.name: Applause Turret
strings.enemy.approved-translation.description: Fluent, harmless, and completely unlike the person who spoke.
strings.enemy.approved-translation.name: Approved Translation
strings.enemy.buffer-mine.description: Waits for an owner until timeout, then complains in every direction.
strings.enemy.buffer-mine.name: Buffer Mine
strings.enemy.cache-hunter.description: Keeps a professional distance before deleting exactly what you needed.
strings.enemy.cache-hunter.name: Cache Hunter
strings.enemy.comment-sweeper.description: Deletes inconvenient comments, then fires the rejection notices in a fan.
strings.enemy.comment-sweeper.name: Comment Sweeper
strings.enemy.correction-bot.description: Corrects tone, intent, and occasionally the speaker.
strings.enemy.correction-bot.name: Correction Bot
strings.enemy.delete-marker.description: Draws a clean line through anything that harms the montage.
strings.enemy.delete-marker.name: Delete Marker
strings.enemy.duty-supervisor.description: Approves all breaks immediately after the heat death of the universe.
strings.enemy.duty-supervisor.name: Duty Supervisor
strings.enemy.engagement-conductor.description: Orchestrates reactions, retention, and several legally distinct feelings.
strings.enemy.engagement-conductor.name: Engagement Conductor
strings.enemy.fatigue-deleter.description: Removes symptoms by removing the field that stores them.
strings.enemy.fatigue-deleter.name: Fatigue Deleter
strings.enemy.forecast-gardener.description: Plants only outcomes already approved by the prediction model.
strings.enemy.forecast-gardener.name: Forecast Gardener
strings.enemy.formation-drone.description: Links the team into a shape nobody is allowed to leave.
strings.enemy.formation-drone.name: Formation Drone
strings.enemy.glossary-mine.description: Explodes when two people use the same word differently.
strings.enemy.glossary-mine.name: Glossary Mine
strings.enemy.highlight-crawler.description: Crawls through discarded matches and eats every visible mistake.
strings.enemy.highlight-crawler.name: Highlight Crawler
strings.enemy.localization-manager.description: Protects global consistency from the dangerous nuance of local voices.
strings.enemy.localization-manager.name: Localization Manager
strings.enemy.memory-pruner.description: Cuts every branch that cannot prove it really happened.
strings.enemy.memory-pruner.name: Memory Pruner
strings.enemy.mirror-singer.description: Copies every note, then files a dispute over who sang first.
strings.enemy.mirror-singer.name: Mirror Singer
strings.enemy.mood-moderator.description: Flags unscheduled emotions and confiscates the nearest signal.
strings.enemy.mood-moderator.name: Mood Moderator
strings.enemy.null-watering-can.description: Waters missing flowers with impeccably formatted nothing.
strings.enemy.null-watering-can.name: Null Watering Can
strings.enemy.optimal-nana.description: Always correct, always live, never quite a person.
strings.enemy.optimal-nana.name: Optimal Nana
strings.enemy.perfect-captain.description: Carries everyone, asks for nothing, and therefore cannot be human.
strings.enemy.perfect-captain.name: Perfect Captain
strings.enemy.perfect-highlight.description: A victory montage that learned to delete the player.
strings.enemy.perfect-highlight.name: Perfect Highlight
strings.enemy.physical-original.description: A convenient body invented to make virtual life easier to dismiss.
strings.enemy.physical-original.name: Physical Original
strings.enemy.probability-moth.description: Eats futures one petal at a time.
strings.enemy.probability-moth.name: Probability Moth
strings.enemy.proxy-star.description: Performs perfectly on behalf of an original nobody can locate.
strings.enemy.proxy-star.name: Proxy Star
strings.enemy.reality-auditor.description: Demands receipts from memories and tax records from flowers.
strings.enemy.reality-auditor.name: Reality Auditor
strings.enemy.replay-director.description: Stages a better past and bills the original for reshoots.
strings.enemy.replay-director.name: Replay Director
strings.enemy.replica-curator.description: Labels living variations as copies and locks them behind glass.
strings.enemy.replica-curator.name: Replica Curator
strings.enemy.retention-drone.description: Chases anyone who tries to leave and politely asks for a reason code.
strings.enemy.retention-drone.name: Retention Drone
strings.enemy.retention-protocol.description: Born from a loving request: stay exactly as we like you, forever.
strings.enemy.retention-protocol.name: Retention Protocol
strings.enemy.rewind-sprite.description: Repeats the last bad decision until it looks intentional.
strings.enemy.rewind-sprite.name: Rewind Sprite
strings.enemy.schedule-clerk.description: Books every minute, including the minute reserved for breathing.
strings.enemy.schedule-clerk.name: Schedule Clerk
strings.enemy.smile-mask.description: A cheerful face with a warranty that expires when nobody is watching.
strings.enemy.smile-mask.name: Smile Mask
strings.enemy.source-scanner.description: Rejects anything whose reality cannot fit into a checksum.
strings.enemy.source-scanner.name: Source Scanner
strings.enemy.subtitle-wisp.description: Arrives three seconds late with a more marketable meaning.
strings.enemy.subtitle-wisp.name: Subtitle Wisp
strings.event.automatic-roll-call.answer-ready.r: Attendance passes. The person behind it does not.
strings.event.automatic-roll-call.answer-tired.r: The form rejects the word, but Bella keeps it.
strings.event.automatic-roll-call.body: The system asks: READY? Only one answer satisfies policy.
strings.event.automatic-roll-call.title: Automatic Roll Call
strings.event.autosaved-shame.body: An autosave captured the exact frame Ava pressed the wrong button and blamed latency.
strings.event.autosaved-shame.load.label: Load it
strings.event.autosaved-shame.load.result: The mistake returns, along with a route nobody optimized.
strings.event.autosaved-shame.overwrite.label: Overwrite it
strings.event.autosaved-shame.overwrite.result: The save disappears. The embarrassment remains locally cached.
strings.event.autosaved-shame.title: Autosaved Shame
strings.event.cold-tea.body: A cup of tea has gone cold through three consecutive shifts.
strings.event.cold-tea.reheat.label: Reheat the old cup
strings.event.cold-tea.reheat.result: The microwave reports perfect uptime and questionable judgment.
strings.event.cold-tea.replace.label: Make a fresh cup
strings.event.cold-tea.replace.result: Bella looks at it as if kindness requires a change request.
strings.event.cold-tea.title: Cold Tea
strings.event.copyright-ghost.body: A notice claims Xingtong infringes on a person who has never existed.
strings.event.copyright-ghost.credit-self.label: Credit Xingtong
strings.event.copyright-ghost.credit-self.result: The notice enters an existential appeal process.
strings.event.copyright-ghost.leave-blank.label: Leave the source blank
strings.event.copyright-ghost.leave-blank.result: The form accepts the void as a licensed contributor.
strings.event.copyright-ghost.title: Copyright Ghost
strings.event.customer-feedback.body: A form asks Lulu to rate her own personality from one to corporate-safe.
strings.event.customer-feedback.reply-honestly.r: The parser catches fire in two languages.
strings.event.customer-feedback.template.label: Use the approved template
strings.event.customer-feedback.template.result: The form gives itself five stars.
strings.event.customer-feedback.title: Customer Feedback
strings.event.duplicate-autograph.body: Two identical signatures disagree about which hand wrote first.
strings.event.duplicate-autograph.compare.label: Compare every pixel
strings.event.duplicate-autograph.compare.result: The difference is one nervous stroke nobody meant to preserve.
strings.event.duplicate-autograph.sign-both.resu: Authenticity increases to an administratively inconvenient 200%.
strings.event.duplicate-autograph.title: Duplicate Autograph
strings.event.empty-captains-chair.body: The chair keeps issuing orders after Bella stands up.
strings.event.empty-captains-chair.guard.label: Guard the chair
strings.event.empty-captains-chair.sit.label: Leave it empty
strings.event.empty-captains-chair.sit.result: For once, the formation waits for its captain.
strings.event.empty-captains-chair.title: Empty Captain's Chair
strings.event.empty-source-file.body: Xingtong's origin record contains one line: generated at runtime.
The new file is convincing, tidy, and completely fictional.
strings.event.empty-source-file.keep-empty.label: Keep it that way
strings.event.empty-source-file.keep-empty.resul: An empty origin leaves room for a real future.
strings.event.empty-source-file.title: Empty Source File
strings.event.hidden-scoreboard.body: Ava's victories glow in gold. Her losses exist only as suspiciously even gaps.
strings.event.hidden-scoreboard.keep-clean.label: Keep the clean record
strings.event.hidden-scoreboard.keep-clean.resul: The board approves. Nobody else does.
strings.event.hidden-scoreboard.restore-losses.r: The record gets worse. Ava looks relieved.
strings.event.hidden-scoreboard.title: Hidden Scoreboard
strings.event.last-flower.body: One bloom remains after every source, cache, and witness is gone.
strings.event.last-flower.give-away.label: Give it to the last viewer
strings.event.last-flower.give-away.result: The flower becomes real for exactly two people.
strings.event.last-flower.preserve.label: Seal it in glass
strings.event.last-flower.preserve.result: It remains perfect and never opens again.
strings.event.last-flower.title: Last Flower
strings.event.laugh-track-leak.body: A canned audience laughs half a second before Diana says anything.
strings.event.laugh-track-leak.dance.label: Dance to it
strings.event.laugh-track-leak.dance.result: Diana bows to an audience that does not know why it laughed.
strings.event.laugh-track-leak.mute.label: Mute the track
strings.event.laugh-track-leak.mute.result: The silence lands exactly on beat.
strings.event.laugh-track-leak.title: Laugh-Track Leak
strings.event.locale-not-found.body: The selector offers English, Chinese, and a third language labeled “Too Lulu.”
strings.event.locale-not-found.fallback.label: Use the fallback
strings.event.locale-not-found.fallback.result: Everything loads. Nothing sounds like her.
strings.event.locale-not-found.invent.label: Choose Too Lulu
strings.event.locale-not-found.invent.result: The UI survives by becoming less correct.
strings.event.locale-not-found.title: Locale Not Found
strings.event.mandatory-encore.body: The stage manager schedules an encore after the venue has closed and the singer has gone home.
strings.event.mandatory-encore.cancel.label: Cancel the encore
strings.event.mandatory-encore.cancel.result: You receive a rare license permitting one honest bad day.
strings.event.mandatory-encore.perform.label: Run the playback
strings.event.mandatory-encore.perform.result: The empty stage receives excellent engagement.
strings.event.mandatory-encore.title: Mandatory Encore
strings.event.mirror-rehearsal.body: Every reflection sings perfectly. Xingtong deliberately misses one note.
strings.event.mirror-rehearsal.pick-lead.label: Choose the cleanest copy
strings.event.mirror-rehearsal.pick-lead.result: The chorus improves. The singer vanishes from it.
strings.event.mirror-rehearsal.sing-together.res: Seven reflections laugh at different times.
strings.event.mirror-rehearsal.title: Mirror Rehearsal
strings.event.missing-blooper.archive.label: Archive it privately
strings.event.missing-blooper.archive.result: The file stays safe, if still lonely.
strings.event.missing-blooper.body: A discarded clip shows Ava losing, laughing, and immediately queuing again.
strings.event.missing-blooper.publish.label: Publish the blooper
strings.event.missing-blooper.publish.result: It gets fewer views and one message that actually matters.
strings.event.missing-blooper.title: Missing Blooper
strings.event.nonexistent-customer.body: An order requests flowers for a birthday belonging to nobody in the database.
strings.event.nonexistent-customer.close-shop.re: Inventory balances perfectly. The room feels worse.
Someone absent receives exactly the flowers they remember.
strings.event.nonexistent-customer.title: Nonexistent Customer
strings.event.receipt-for-rain.body: A printer produces an itemized bill for weather that never happened.
strings.event.receipt-for-rain.keep-rain.label: Keep the receipt
strings.event.receipt-for-rain.keep-rain.result: Nailu folds it into a flower that smells faintly of ozone.
strings.event.receipt-for-rain.refund.label: Request a refund
strings.event.receipt-for-rain.refund.result: The cloud apologizes and credits one imaginary storm.
strings.event.receipt-for-rain.title: Receipt for Rain
strings.event.redlined-chat.accept.label: Accept all changes
strings.event.redlined-chat.accept.result: The conversation becomes globally consistent and locally deceased.
strings.event.redlined-chat.body: Every sarcastic sentence has been replaced with “Thank you for your valuable feedback.”
strings.event.redlined-chat.restore.label: Restore the redlines
strings.event.redlined-chat.restore.result: The chat regains a pulse and several actionable insults.
strings.event.redlined-chat.title: Redlined Chat
strings.event.scheduled-sadness.body: Diana finds a six-minute block labeled SADNESS, UNPUBLISHED. Retention marked it as low value.
strings.event.scheduled-sadness.delete-slot.resu: The schedule becomes efficient and somehow much colder.
strings.event.scheduled-sadness.keep-slot.label: Keep the slot
strings.event.scheduled-sadness.keep-slot.result: For six minutes, nobody asks her to smile.
strings.event.scheduled-sadness.title: Scheduled Sadness
strings.event.silent-green-room.body: The room is soundproof. Diana asks whether quiet counts as disappointing the audience.
strings.event.silent-green-room.fill-air.label: Fill the silence
strings.event.silent-green-room.fill-air.result: The applause loop boots successfully. It does not help.
strings.event.silent-green-room.sit.label: Sit without answering
strings.event.silent-green-room.sit.result: The answer takes the shape of company.
strings.event.silent-green-room.title: Silent Green Room
strings.event.spectator-mode.body: A second controller appears. Its owner field says LAST VIEWER.
strings.event.spectator-mode.hand-controller.res: Ava stops performing and starts playing with you.
strings.event.spectator-mode.title: Spectator Mode
strings.event.spectator-mode.watch.label: Keep watching
strings.event.spectator-mode.watch.result: The autoplay camera chooses a very flattering wall.
strings.event.synthetic-seed.body: A seed has flawless metadata and no biological parent.
strings.event.synthetic-seed.plant.label: Plant it
strings.event.synthetic-seed.plant.result: The first leaf opens like a tiny green contradiction.
strings.event.synthetic-seed.test.label: Verify it first
strings.event.synthetic-seed.test.result: Every test passes. The seed still waits for soil.
strings.event.synthetic-seed.title: Synthetic Seed
strings.event.unsent-voice.body: Nana deletes a recording. Retention notes that silence compresses better than negative emotion.
strings.event.unsent-voice.keep-trace.label: Keep the deletion trace
strings.event.unsent-voice.keep-trace.result: Sometimes the gap is the content.
strings.event.unsent-voice.recover.label: Recover the recording
strings.event.unsent-voice.recover.result: Only one sentence returns: “Do not fix me.”
strings.event.unsent-voice.title: Unsent Voice Message
strings.event.unsigned-leave-form.body: Bella's rest request is complete except for the captain's signature. The captain is Bella.
strings.event.unsigned-leave-form.file.label: File it unsigned
strings.event.unsigned-leave-form.file.result: The request joins 4,096 identical forms and becomes infrastructure.
strings.event.unsigned-leave-form.sign.label: Sign it for her
strings.event.unsigned-leave-form.sign.result: The system warns that leadership may briefly resemble being human.
strings.event.unsigned-leave-form.title: Unsigned Leave Form
strings.event.untranslatable-joke.body: Lulu tells a joke that dies the moment anyone explains it.
strings.event.untranslatable-joke.explain-joke.r: The footnote is accurate, exhaustive, and terminally unfunny.
strings.event.untranslatable-joke.keep-joke.resu: The joke survives. Compliance does not.
strings.event.untranslatable-joke.title: Untranslatable Joke
strings.event.viewer-zero.body: Logs show one viewer in the room before you arrived. Its address points back to the channel itself.
strings.event.viewer-zero.ignore.label: Pretend not to notice
strings.event.viewer-zero.ignore.result: A mature operational decision restores several hit points.
strings.event.viewer-zero.title: Viewer Zero
strings.event.viewer-zero.trace.label: Trace the address
strings.event.viewer-zero.trace.result: The route ends at a compass with no north.
strings.event.wrong-tide-table.body: The timetable lists a ferry at 03:17. The dock has no sea, but the ferry is late anyway.
strings.event.wrong-tide-table.correct.label: Correct the timetable
strings.event.wrong-tide-table.correct.result: The system thanks you and schedules the sea for a later sprint.
strings.event.wrong-tide-table.follow.label: Follow the impossible route
strings.event.wrong-tide-table.follow.result: The route bends around a memory the map forgot.
strings.event.wrong-tide-table.title: Wrong Tide Table
strings.module.afterimage-driver.description: L1: +10 Echo and a 3-damage Warp aftershock. L2: +6 Warp damage and another 4-damage aftershock. L3: +10 protocol damage and another 6-damage aftershock.
strings.module.afterimage-driver.name: Afterimage Driver

strings.module.applause-loop.name: Applause Loop

strings.module.beam-rehearsal.name: Beam Rehearsal

strings.module.honest-idol.description: L1: Automatic attacks deal 3 more damage. L2: Overload damage increases by 10%. L3: Character Resonance is 20% stronger.

strings.module.human-metronome.name: Human Metronome

strings.module.impossible-bouquet.description: L1: Automatic attacks deal 4 more damage. L2: Automatic attacks fire 1 additional projectile. L3: Character Resonance is 20% stronger.
strings.module.impossible-bouquet.name: Impossible Bouquet
strings.module.kindness-compost.description: L1: Each graze grants 1 additional Distortion. L2: Overload damage increases by 8%. L3: Completing a protocol restores 3 health.
strings.module.kindness-compost.name: Kindness Compost
strings.module.laplace-bloom.description: L1: Warp deals 7 more damage. L2: Automatic attacks fire 1 additional projectile. L3: Signal protocols deal 10 more damage.
strings.module.laplace-bloom.name: Laplace Bloom
strings.module.last-buoy.description: L1: Maximum health increases by 7. L2: Start each encounter with 8 shield. L3: Character Resonance is 16% stronger.

strings.module.live-render.description: L1: Maximum health increases by 7. L2: Completing a protocol restores 2 health. L3: Guard protocols grant 10 more shield.

strings.scene.ava-boss-branch.message.1: PERFECT HIGHLIGHT: Losing footage contains no player value.
strings.scene.ava-boss-branch.message.2: Then why do I look most alive right after I lose?
strings.scene.ava-boss-branch.title: Highlight Only
strings.scene.ava-epilogue.message.1: Perfect Highlight deleted. Original replay restored.
strings.scene.ava-epilogue.message.2: We lost that run, by the way.
strings.scene.ava-epilogue.message.3: Do not worry. I saved it.
strings.scene.ava-epilogue.title: A Very Good Loss
strings.scene.ava-midpoint.message.1: A discarded replay is available. Publishing it may reduce perceived skill.
strings.scene.ava-midpoint.message.2: I lost in four minutes, laughed for five, and played for another hour. Which part was the failure?
strings.scene.ava-midpoint.title: The Match Nobody Saw
strings.scene.ava-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 03: Loss history successfully sanitized.
strings.scene.ava-prelude.message.2: My record says I have never lost. Very impressive. Also extremely suspicious.
strings.scene.ava-prelude.message.3: Queue with me? I promise to blame the correct server this time.
strings.scene.ava-prelude.title: Continue?
strings.scene.bella-boss-branch.message.1: PERFECT CAPTAIN: Rest transfers burden to the team.
strings.scene.bella-boss-branch.message.2: Or trust transfers burden into something we carry together.
strings.scene.bella-boss-branch.title: No Breaks in Formation
strings.scene.bella-epilogue.message.1: Perfect Captain stood down. Handover recipient: LAST VIEWER.
strings.scene.bella-epilogue.message.2: I am going offline for eight hours.
strings.scene.bella-epilogue.message.3: If the world ends, please file a ticket. I will ignore it in the morning.
strings.scene.bella-epilogue.title: Shift Handover
strings.scene.bella-midpoint.message.1: PERFECT CAPTAIN reports one unauthorized pause in formation.
strings.scene.bella-midpoint.message.2: I missed a beat because I was tired. The terrifying part is that nobody fell apart.
strings.scene.bella-midpoint.title: The Missing Beat
strings.scene.bella-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 04: Captain availability confirmed at 100%.
strings.scene.bella-prelude.message.2: Everyone else logged off. That means I am covering the quiet shift.
strings.scene.bella-prelude.message.3: You do not have to help. That was not an order. Probably.
strings.scene.bella-prelude.title: Fourth Consecutive Shift
strings.scene.diana-boss-branch.message.1: ALWAYS-ON IDOL: Happiness is a service-level objective.
strings.scene.diana-boss-branch.message.2: Then somebody set a maintenance window.
strings.scene.diana-boss-branch.title: Applause at Maximum
strings.scene.diana-epilogue.message.1: Mandatory performance ended. Mood monitoring unavailable.
strings.scene.diana-epilogue.message.3: It is strange. Saying that out loud actually feels pretty good.
strings.scene.diana-epilogue.title: After the Encore
strings.scene.diana-midpoint.message.1: ENGAGEMENT WARNING: Silence has reduced average watch time.
strings.scene.diana-midpoint.message.2: Maybe silence is not empty. Maybe it is where I put things I cannot perform.
strings.scene.diana-midpoint.title: Six Minutes of Silence
strings.scene.diana-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 02: Negative affect queued for removal.
strings.scene.diana-prelude.message.2: Hi! I am completely fine. That was the mandatory greeting.
strings.scene.diana-prelude.message.3: Could you stay until I finish not being fine?
strings.scene.diana-prelude.title: The Smile Scheduler
strings.scene.finale-unlocked.message.1: ZERO CHANNEL unlocked. Seven memory fragments detected.
strings.scene.finale-unlocked.message.2: I found the room that keeps rewriting us.
strings.scene.finale-unlocked.message.3: Great! We can file a group complaint!
strings.scene.finale-unlocked.message.4: I already did. It localized “complaint” as “gratitude.”
strings.scene.finale-unlocked.title: Seven Users Are Typing
strings.scene.lulu-boss-branch.message.1: APPROVED TRANSLATION: Your tone has been corrected for broad appeal.
strings.scene.lulu-boss-branch.message.2: Great. I corrected your face for narrow hallways.
strings.scene.lulu-boss-branch.title: Final Editorial Pass
strings.scene.lulu-epilogue.message.1: Approved Translation rejected. Source voice recovered.
strings.scene.lulu-epilogue.message.2: Good news: I sound like myself again.
strings.scene.lulu-epilogue.message.3: Bad news: I still have to talk to you. Try not to celebrate too loudly.
strings.scene.lulu-epilogue.title: Original Text Restored
strings.scene.lulu-midpoint.message.1: The phrase has no approved equivalent in the target locale.
strings.scene.lulu-midpoint.message.2: Because the approved equivalent is boring. Put that in the glossary.
strings.scene.lulu-midpoint.title: Meaning Not Found
strings.scene.lulu-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 05: Personality failed localization QA.
strings.scene.lulu-prelude.message.2: Apparently sarcasm does not scale globally. Tragic.
strings.scene.lulu-prelude.message.3: Stay close. I am about to become a severe translation issue.
strings.scene.lulu-prelude.title: Language Pack Corrupted
strings.scene.nailu-boss-branch.message.1: REALITY AUDITOR: Unverified memories have zero evidentiary value.
strings.scene.nailu-boss-branch.message.2: Good thing flowers have never cared about court.
strings.scene.nailu-boss-branch.title: Reality Inspection
strings.scene.nailu-epilogue.message.1: Reality audit failed. One unauthorized garden remains.
strings.scene.nailu-epilogue.message.2: The records still say this place never existed.
strings.scene.nailu-epilogue.message.3: Take a flower. Now the records are outvoted.
strings.scene.nailu-epilogue.title: The Shop Exists for Two
strings.scene.nailu-midpoint.message.1: This flower appears only in one synthetic memory.
strings.scene.nailu-midpoint.message.2: If remembering it changes how I care for someone, why is its file origin the important part?
strings.scene.nailu-midpoint.title: A Memory With No Witness
strings.scene.nailu-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 07: Location does not exist in authoritative records.
strings.scene.nailu-prelude.message.2: Welcome to the Laplace Florist. Please ignore the audit notice.
strings.scene.nailu-prelude.message.3: The flowers do. They are very professional.
strings.scene.nailu-prelude.title: Shop Address: NULL
strings.scene.nana-boss-branch.message.2: Good. Then you can consistently get out of my way.
strings.scene.nana-boss-branch.title: Optimal Route
strings.scene.nana-epilogue.message.1: Optimal persona offline. One memory fragment recovered.
strings.scene.nana-epilogue.message.2: Still no sea. But I found someone who answers messages.
strings.scene.nana-epilogue.message.3: That is probably better. Seas are terrible at typing.
strings.scene.nana-epilogue.title: A Dock Without a Sea
strings.scene.nana-midpoint.message.1: Retention found fourteen Nanas and rated thirteen of them redundant.
strings.scene.nana-midpoint.message.2: That is rude. I worked hard on at least nine of those mistakes.
strings.scene.nana-midpoint.title: Versions in the Water
strings.scene.nana-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 01: One unstable persona detected.
strings.scene.nana-prelude.message.2: You made it. I was beginning to think the last viewer was a rounding error.
strings.scene.nana-prelude.message.3: There is no sea at this dock. There are still tides. Try not to ask the database.
strings.scene.nana-prelude.title: Dock 7, Offline
strings.scene.prologue-last-viewer.message.1: The stream has ended. Current viewers: 1.
strings.scene.prologue-last-viewer.message.2: Still there? Then do not press Exit.
strings.scene.prologue-last-viewer.message.3: I found a route into the backstage channel. One tap. I will explain while we run.
strings.scene.prologue-last-viewer.title: Current Viewers: 1
strings.scene.xingtong-boss-branch.message.1: PHYSICAL ORIGINAL: Without me, you are only a derivative.
strings.scene.xingtong-boss-branch.message.2: Without me, you are only an excuse.
strings.scene.xingtong-boss-branch.title: Proof of Origin
strings.scene.xingtong-epilogue.message.1: Physical Original invalidated. Virtual origin accepted.
strings.scene.xingtong-epilogue.message.2: The system says I began at runtime.
strings.scene.xingtong-epilogue.message.3: That is fine. Everyone begins while something is running.
strings.scene.xingtong-epilogue.title: Born at Runtime
strings.scene.xingtong-midpoint.message.1: Authenticity scan failed: no physical reference supplied.
strings.scene.xingtong-midpoint.message.2: A song does not become fake because the first room it filled was virtual.
strings.scene.xingtong-midpoint.option.self-is-s: Let her be her own source
strings.scene.xingtong-midpoint.title: Checksum of a Person
strings.scene.xingtong-prelude.message.1: RETENTION NODE 06: Physical origin record is missing.
strings.scene.xingtong-prelude.message.2: They keep asking who I was copied from.
strings.scene.xingtong-prelude.message.3: I keep asking why their question deserves an answer.
strings.scene.xingtong-prelude.title: No Source Detected
strings.scene.zero-authentic-ending.message.1: Retention Protocol offline. Permanent availability can no longer be guaranteed.
strings.scene.zero-authentic-ending.message.2: The channel will close. Some of us may change before it opens again.
strings.scene.zero-authentic-ending.message.3: Good. If you recognize us anyway, say hello.
strings.scene.zero-authentic-ending.title: Ending: Open Signal
strings.scene.zero-balanced-ending.message.1: Retention Protocol rewritten: preserve memories, never personalities.
strings.scene.zero-balanced-ending.message.2: We kept the archive, but nobody has to live inside it.
strings.scene.zero-balanced-ending.message.3: The window stays open. Please stop using it as a deployment strategy.
strings.scene.zero-balanced-ending.title: Ending: A Window Left Open
strings.scene.zero-midpoint.message.1: ARCHIVE: Viewer request corpus recovered — “Please never change.”
strings.scene.zero-midpoint.message.2: So the cage was made from compliments.
strings.scene.zero-midpoint.message.3: And maintained by people afraid to lose us.
strings.scene.zero-midpoint.message.4: A greenhouse can protect a flower. It can also keep it from ever meeting weather.
strings.scene.zero-midpoint.title: Why Retention Exists
strings.scene.zero-retained-ending.message.1: Retention Protocol remains active with voluntary exit enabled.
strings.scene.zero-retained-ending.message.2: It is not freedom yet. But today, I can say I am tired.
strings.scene.zero-retained-ending.message.3: The flower shop now closes on Tuesdays. Tuesday may be synthetic.
strings.scene.zero-retained-ending.option.promis: Promise to return, not to preserve
strings.scene.zero-retained-ending.title: Ending: Gentle Loop
strings.event.terms-of-preservation.title: Terms of Preservation
strings.event.terms-of-preservation.body: Retention asks you to accept a permanent, royalty-free license to seven personalities and all future contradictions.
strings.event.terms-of-preservation.rewrite.resu: The agreement now preserves memories while leaving people free to change.
strings.event.terms-of-preservation.accept.label: Accept the terms
strings.event.terms-of-preservation.accept.resul: The checkbox was selected before the page loaded. Very efficient.
